intro: This is home base for broadcast-audio projects, field tools, troubleshooting ideas, and whatever ends up on the bench next — the stuff that comes out of long days in trucks, booths, and equipment rooms.
Some of it is finished. Some of it is a working theory. All of it started with something that didn't sound right.
